Answer the customer's question using ONLY this policy. If the policy does not cover the question, reply exactly NOT_COVERED.

<policy>
Annual plans can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Monthly plans are not refundable; cancelling stops the next charge. Refunds arrive within 5 business days. The billing date cannot be moved.
</policy>

Question: I bought an annual plan 10 days ago, can I get a refund?

[eval run 1]

response.text: Yes, you can get a full refund since annual plans can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Refunds arrive within 5 business days.
